pages.title: Anime Couple: Avatar Maker
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Design a pair of characters in Anime Couple: Avatar Maker. Choose outfits, hairstyles, and accessories for the anime avatars and coordinate their appearances. Mix the available features to create a couple with its own style.

pages.title: Bimka Drive - Smash cars into splinters!
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Test destructible vehicles in Bimka Drive - Smash cars into splinters! Select a car and mode, then drive into obstacles to see how impacts change the vehicle. Try different models and tracks to compare the results of their collisions.

pages.title: Arrow Slide Puzzle
pages.creator: Clever Apps Pte. Ltd.
pages.description: Reveal an image in Arrow Slide Puzzle. Tap each arrow to send it in its pointing direction and clear it from the board. Use the open spaces to remove pieces without collisions until the full picture beneath is visible.

pages.title: Shell Strikers
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Command a squad in turn-based Shell Strikers. Move a soldier into position, account for the wind, and aim a weapon before firing. Choose among rockets, bombs, lasers, airstrikes, and dynamite while managing their limited ammunition.

pages.title: Fruit King Merge
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Launch matching produce in Fruit King Merge. Shoot fruit from the center toward an identical piece on the surrounding circle to merge them into a higher-value type. Earn coins, discover more fruits, and work toward a larger score.

pages.title: Miner's Fury!
pages.creator: Realinspirer
pages.description: Break incoming stone waves in Miner's Fury! Move clear of rocks while attacking them, then collect the coins they release. Deploy turrets and buy improvements to damage, earnings, and support weapons, with missions offering additional rewards.

pages.title: Peckshot
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Stop an aiming arrow at the right moment in Peckshot. Tap to fire when it points at the target and keep landing successful shots. A miss ends the attempt, while earned coins unlock other skins.

pages.title: Sailor Chic vs Pirate Charm
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Style two sea-themed heroines in Sailor Chic vs Pirate Charm. Give Amelie a polished maritime look and explore leather, corsets, and pirate details for Jacqueline. Compare the available clothing and accessories to create their contrasting outfits.

pages.title: Dead Zone Mech Ops
pages.creator: Breymantech
pages.description: Pilot a combat machine in Dead Zone Mech Ops. Move through a war-damaged environment and use the mounted weapons to fight opposing forces. Control movement with WASD and fire with the mouse buttons during the battles.

pages.title: One Line
pages.creator: Playable Factory
pages.description: Draw protection around a vulnerable character in One Line. Use a single stroke to block rain, bees, giants, or another threat in the scene. Plan how the line covers the danger so the man can remain safe.

pages.title: Royal Rebellion Punk Magic
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Create rebellious fantasy fashion in Royal Rebellion Punk Magic. Combine leather dresses, spikes, rivets, bold makeup, and piercings for two friends. Choose hairstyles and accessories that complete each girl's punk-inspired look.

pages.title: Extreme Makeover Harley Edition
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Change a familiar villain's style in Extreme Makeover Harley Edition. Start by removing her signature hair colors, then work through makeup and manicure activities. Finish the transformation with a bright outfit for her trip through Gotham City.

pages.title: Dress Princess
pages.creator: yiyuan
pages.description: Become a stylist in Dress Princess. Choose an evening gown or a casual outfit, then add necklaces, earrings, and other accessories. Try different combinations to make the princess's finished look your own.

pages.title: Sprunki Challenge
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Make sound combinations in Sprunki Challenge. Play the classic solo activity or compete with another player to generate a score of two thousand. Switch between normal and dark settings and try different backgrounds during the music-making contest.

pages.title: BFFs Golden Hour
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Prepare four friends for autumn photos in BFFs Golden Hour. Choose outfits, makeup, and accessories for Elsa, Ellie, Kiki, and Regina. Finish their looks and take pictures for the group's seasonal album.

pages.title: Aloha Mahjong
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Clear island-themed layouts in Aloha Mahjong. Select identical Hawaiian tiles that are uncovered and have at least one open side. Remove every pair to complete the board in this daily tile-matching activity.

pages.title: Last Day On Earth Survival
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Explore a ruined city in Last Day On Earth Survival. Gather wood and metal, craft weapons at the workbench, and improve health, attack, speed, or searching as you gain levels. Discover fifty-one locations while working toward surviving fifty days.

pages.title: Flora Combinatorix
pages.creator: Itmium Limited
pages.description: Grow a greenhouse collection in Flora Combinatorix. Prepare pots, combine matching plants into new varieties, and keep the shelves free of dust. Earn coins, buy plants, and improve production while discovering forty hidden flower types.

pages.title: City Rider
pages.creator: Faramel Games
pages.description: Explore three urban maps in City Rider. Choose among nine vehicles, including racing cars, buses, and trucks, and compare how they handle the streets. Use WASD to drive and the number controls to change cars.

pages.title: BlockBuster Puzzle
pages.creator: Clever Apps Pte. Ltd.
pages.description: Fit shapes into a grid in BlockBuster Puzzle. Choose offered blocks and complete rows or columns to remove them for points. Plan placements to clear several lines together, and use boosters when obstacles leave little space.

pages.title: Stone Miner 3D
pages.creator: CHETRUSCA SOFTWORKS S.R.L
pages.description: Drive a crushing machine in Stone Miner 3D. Break the rocks along the route, sell the collected material, and develop an office for the operation. Avoid people and other trailers while working toward the finish, since a trailer collision ends the attempt.

pages.title: Craft Conflict
pages.creator: Adomori
pages.description: Build a fighting force in Craft Conflict. Collect gold and stone to construct towers and recruit warriors, mages, and archers. Combine the available defenses and troops to fight for control of new territory.

pages.title: Solitaire Farm Seasons 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Clear cards while developing a farm in Solitaire Farm Seasons 2. Select an exposed card one rank above or below the current card to continue the chain. Complete thousands of countryside levels, grow crops, and take on daily missions between the card puzzles.

pages.title: Mine Shooter: Huggy's Attack!
pages.creator: Berezka
pages.description: Repel invading creatures in Mine Shooter: Huggy's Attack! Move through the block-built battlefield, shoot the monsters, and throw bombs when useful. Collect money during the fighting and spend it on more powerful weapons for later encounters.

pages.title: Fruit Lines
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Make lines of five in Fruit Lines. Move fruit to an empty square when a clear path connects the positions. A move without a completed row adds three pieces, so keep clearing matching horizontal or vertical lines before the board fills.

pages.title: Bounce and Collect
pages.creator: VOODOO
pages.description: Multiply a falling collection in Bounce and Collect. Tip cups to send balls through bonus areas that increase their number. Choose routes around obstacles and gather enough in the final cup to unlock the next challenge.

pages.title: Unblock Cube 3D
pages.creator: playmarketing ou
pages.description: Dismantle a cube-shaped arrangement in Unblock Cube 3D. Rotate the model to inspect its sides, then tap pieces with a clear path in their movement direction. Remove every block to finish the level and receive its reward.

pages.title: Keep Zombie away
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Prepare a refuge in Keep Zombie away. Reach a safe room before the pursuing monsters, shut the door, and settle onto the bed. Improve the room's security measures to hold back the attack and survive longer.

pages.title: Huggie & Kissy The magic temple
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Explore ancient chambers in Huggie & Kissy The magic temple. Switch between the two characters to handle water, solve mechanisms, and open doors while gathering diamonds. Complete twenty platform levels alone or bring a friend into the adventure.

pages.title: Wuggy Adventures
pages.creator: Firstpixel
pages.description: Search mysterious islands in Wuggy Adventures. Help Huggy run and jump through obstacles while battling hostile monsters. Continue through the dangerous world toward the treasure waiting at the journey's destination.

pages.title: Speedrun platformer
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Chase faster finishes in Speedrun platformer. Run and jump through trap-filled levels while looking for secrets along the route. Use the left and right arrows with the up-arrow jump to work toward a better place on the leaderboard.

pages.title: Adventure Joystick Winter
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Collect ore in Adventure Joystick Winter. Guide the small controller character around thorns and rotating wheels while gathering every required mineral. Pick up the key and reach the door to finish the snowy stage.

pages.title: A Mole in a Hole
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Help a forgetful creature return home in A Mole in a Hole. Study the map and use the on-screen choices to direct the mole through its tunnels. Choose the correct paths to reach his waiting wife before dinner.

pages.title: Zoo Slings
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Swing animals into a basket in Zoo Slings. Launch from and catch round wooden supports until the character reaches the goal. Guide six animal types through twenty levels, working around the new obstacles introduced along the way.

pages.title: Destroy Figures
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Hold back falling shapes in Destroy Figures. Aim small projectiles from the brown ball to break the descending white objects before they cross the dotted boundary. Make the most of ten shots by targeting clusters that can be hit together.

pages.title: Survival Squidly Game
pages.creator: Gamealliz
pages.description: Survive contest rounds in Survival Squidly Game. Follow the rules for challenges such as Red Light, Green Light, candy cutting, tug of war, marbles, and the glass bridge. Complete the trials to pursue the final in-game prize.

pages.title: Adventures with Pets! Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: Navy Spade
pages.description: Help solve Gardenland's mystery in Adventures with Pets! Bubble Shooter. Aim and match bubbles to complete levels after a storm turns the villagers into animals. Renovate the garden between puzzles and follow Alice's search for the cause of the transformation.

pages.title: Prickle Enemy
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Gather points between moving hazards in Prickle Enemy. Tap to guide the circle toward a dot while spiked opponents approach from either side. Collect more dots before one of the enemies reaches the character.

pages.title: Make Pop its
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Build a poppable pattern in Make Pop its. Place bubble parts into the grid until they form a complete bubble, then pop it to remove four adjacent blocks. Use repositioning or removal power-ups when the board becomes crowded and chase a higher score.

pages.title: Rage Quit Racer
pages.creator: Drmop Games
pages.description: Race through lethal passages in Rage Quit Racer. Rotate left or right to avoid asteroids, bombs, ships, and other barriers while the speed keeps pushing you forward. Collect points, build shields, and reach the tunnel's end to escape.

pages.title: Wall Ball 3D
pages.creator: IzelgueGames
pages.description: Follow a narrow course in Wall Ball 3D. Tap to reverse the ball's direction before it rolls over an edge. Keep reacting to the changing route to extend the distance and beat your previous score.

pages.title: Evil Santa
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Experiment with a ragdoll in Evil Santa. Spawn weapons or special abilities and use them to strike the Santa character. Try the available tools to see how their impacts move him around the sandbox.

pages.title: Mansion Solitaire
pages.creator: SUCCESS Corporation
pages.description: Build a card structure in Mansion Solitaire. Drag cards into the mansion arrangement and use calculations to choose suitable placements. Complete four floors on normal difficulty or take on a five-floor building in hard mode.

pages.title: Sugar Heroes
pages.creator: Clever Apps Pte. Ltd.
pages.description: Help save a city through sweet puzzles in Sugar Heroes. Match candies in rows, remove obstacles, and work through hundreds of levels. Take part in multiplayer tournaments or complete daily tasks to earn additional gold.

pages.title: Mercedes Benz E63 AMG Estate Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rearrange vehicle pictures in Mercedes Benz E63 AMG Estate Slide. Pick from three images and three puzzle modes, then slide the scattered sections into position. Match the car's details to complete the full estate-car image.

pages.title: Police Auto Rickshaw Taxi Game
pages.creator: MaxZoon
pages.description: Patrol city streets in Police Auto Rickshaw Taxi Game. Drive a police tuk-tuk and pursue robbers and other criminals during your assignments. Use the arrow keys to steer through the urban vehicle chase.

pages.title: Happy Glass Thirsty Fish
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Draw a water route in Happy Glass Thirsty Fish. Sketch a line that guides the liquid into the empty glass and fills it. Consider the flow before drawing so the water reaches the container rather than spilling away.

pages.title: Modern City Ambulance Simulator
pages.creator: Pixel Studio
pages.description: Transport injured passengers in Modern City Ambulance Simulator. Drive through city traffic and bring the patients to the hospital. Use the arrow keys to handle the ambulance and the space bar to brake through difficult sections.

pages.title: Knife hit Master
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description: Throw blades into a wooden target in Knife hit Master. Time each launch to place it safely as the target's speed changes. Keep landing successful knives, because a failed throw ends the attempt without another chance.

pages.title: Tic Tac Toe Vegas
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Make a winning line in Tic Tac Toe Vegas. Place Xs or Os to complete three across a row, column, or diagonal while blocking the other side. Play against the computer or a friend and follow the score above the neon grid.

pages.title: Bike Stunt Master Game 3D
pages.creator: toplight studio
pages.description: Ride stunt courses in Bike Stunt Master Game 3D. Use the motorcycle to perform tricks and navigate the track's difficult sections. Work through thirty levels as you improve control over the bike's movement.

pages.title: Kissing in Music Class
pages.creator: Gamer Games
pages.description: Help two students share a secret in Kissing in Music Class. Use mouse or touch controls to make the couple kiss while watching for interruptions. Stop before anyone catches them to keep their classroom romance hidden.

pages.title: Merge the Numbers
pages.creator: Eagle Games
pages.description: Create larger values in Merge the Numbers. Drag equal-numbered pieces together to combine them and increase their value. Keep finding useful matches as you work toward a higher score.

pages.title: Stickman Counter Terror Shooter
pages.creator: Best Games Studios
pages.description: Fight armed stick figures in Stickman Counter Terror Shooter. Move through the level in a first-person view and use rifles, a pistol, or grenades against the opposing team. Change position with the keyboard while aiming and firing with the mouse.

pages.title: Onnect Pair Matching Puzzle
pages.creator: Bubito
pages.description: Clear sweet pictures in Onnect Pair Matching Puzzle. Select identical chocolate and dessert tiles that connect through a route of at most three straight segments. Remove the pairs and keep opening paths through the remaining arrangement.

pages.title: Super Fast Racing Bikes Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Assemble twelve motorcycle pictures in Super Fast Racing Bikes Jigsaw. Choose a 25-, 49-, or 100-piece layout for the selected image. Arrange the pieces until the full racing-bike scene is restored.

pages.title: Cute Animals Coloring
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Paint wildlife drawings in Cute Animals Coloring. Choose shades for the outlined creatures and apply them with the mouse. Work through the picture's different details to create your own finished animal artwork.

pages.title: Blocky Gun Paintball 3
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Take on colorful firefights in Blocky Gun Paintball 3. Play alone against computer-controlled enemies or join multiplayer contests such as teams, free-for-all, and gun game. Move through the block-styled map while aiming and firing at opposing characters.

pages.title: X Mas Jigsaw
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Rebuild seasonal scenes in X Mas Jigsaw. Use the mouse to fit the scattered pieces into complete Christmas pictures. Compare their edges and illustrated details to find the right place for each part.

pages.title: My Cute Room Decor
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Prepare a bedroom for visitors in My Cute Room Decor. Help Susan arrange a comfortable bed, soft toys, and other furnishings before her friends' sleepover. Finish the room's design and see her reaction to the result.

pages.title: Falling Balls
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Guide physics-driven pieces in Falling Balls. Use the left mouse button to control the balls' movement toward the collection area. Complete the current level's target before continuing to another falling-ball arrangement.

pages.title: Chef Hero
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Enter culinary contests in Chef Hero. Prepare dishes as Hero travels along the path to becoming a master cook. Discover recipes and food cultures through the adventure while challenging other chefs.

pages.title: Watermelon Shooting
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Practice shooting at fruit in Watermelon Shooting. Aim a handgun at the watermelons and fire to burst the targets. Use the right mouse button to zoom and work through more than twenty shooting levels.

pages.title: Wild Wild West Memory
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Remember frontier-themed pictures in Wild Wild West Memory. Reveal cards in pairs and match identical images across four levels. Try to complete every board with fewer moves by remembering the designs you have already seen.

pages.title: Happy Halloween
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Pair seasonal cards in Happy Halloween. Reveal two pictures at a time and look for the same design on both. Remember their locations so you can clear the remaining Halloween matches.

pages.title: Nutmeg Football
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Aim through the goalkeeper's stance in Nutmeg Football. Send the ball between the keeper's legs to score, then line up another attempt. Try to improve the total before making three mistakes and ending the game.

pages.title: Dino Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Restore nine prehistoric pictures in Dino Jigsaw. Choose a scene and a layout with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Assemble the image as quickly as possible by matching the shapes and dinosaur details.

pages.title: Super Kid Perfect Jump
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Make a centered landing in Super Kid Perfect Jump. Adjust the launch angle and momentum, then release the rope with a click or touch. Reach the middle of the next platform to keep the character alive and continue jumping.

pages.title: Puppy Puzzle Time
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Put together dog pictures in Puppy Puzzle Time. Choose easy, medium, or hard difficulty and drag the scattered pieces into the image. Work through the scenes at your own pace because there is no countdown timer.

pages.title: EG True False
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Judge equations in EG True False. Read each arithmetic statement and quickly select whether it is right or wrong. Keep responding accurately as the pace increases and try to add more points before making a mistake.

pages.title: Kids Cartoon Jigsaw
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Reassemble illustrated scenes in Kids Cartoon Jigsaw. Select an easy, medium, or hard layout for each picture and fit the pieces together. With no timer, you can examine the details before placing another part.

pages.title: Ultimate Pong
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Play paddle football in Ultimate Pong. Drag the paddle to return the ball and send it into the opponent's goal. Choose easy, difficult, or expert play and adjust to the pace of the rallies.

pages.title: Kill The Guy
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Time a decisive shot in Kill The Guy. Aim at the opposing character and try to hit the head for a powered shot. Make the attempt count, since the challenge gives you no room for a miss.

pages.title: Fashion Shoes Designer
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Create footwear for a competition in Fashion Shoes Designer. Choose the shoes' colors, patterns, and other design details. Complete an original pair and submit it to the event's judging panel.

pages.title: Harajuku Princess
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Explore Japanese street-fashion combinations in Harajuku Princess. Dress Jasmine, Tiana, and Elsa with pieces inspired by styles such as Lolita, cosplay, fairy kei, and punk. Mix the clothes, hairstyles, and accessories into individual outfits.

pages.title: Color Loop
pages.creator: Dreamly Games
pages.description: Remember four-color patterns in Color Loop. Watch the order in which the colors appear and repeat the sequence correctly. Continue handling longer repetitions as you work toward the game's hundredth level.

pages.title: Arena Shooter
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Enter a multiplayer firefight in Arena Shooter. Move around the arena, aim and fire, reload, and switch between weapons with the number keys. Use jumps to change position while confronting the opposing players.

pages.title: Dot Adventure
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Guide a colored ball through dangerous maps in Dot Adventure. Avoid spikes, fire, and other hazards while navigating the level. A collision sends you back to its beginning, so study the route before the next movement.

pages.title: Big Hunter Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Provide for a hungry tribe in Big Hunter Online. Hunt large prehistoric animals, earn money from successful attempts, and buy new weapons. Use better equipment to take on the giant targets and improve your hunting score.

pages.title: Equilibrium
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description: Keep a performer upright in Equilibrium. Maintain balance on the tightrope while wind and objects falling from above disrupt the attempt. Last longer to improve your record and unlock additional walkers.

pages.title: Catwoman Pregnant
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Join a superhero for a prenatal visit in Catwoman Pregnant. Follow the examination activities to check the baby and prepare a picture for Batman. Use the mouse to help complete the appointment.

pages.title: Master Chess
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Play a traditional board contest in Master Chess. Select and move pieces with the mouse while planning attacks against the opposing king. Challenge the computer or share the board with a friend locally.

pages.title: Silly Ways to Die: Differences
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Compare the characters' scenes in Silly Ways to Die: Differences. Find the changed details between the pictures before the timer runs out. Work quickly and accurately to improve the score through the visual-search challenge.

pages.title: Robin Hood: Give and Take
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Sneak through guarded places in Robin Hood: Give and Take. Steal gold from castle chests, then return it to poorer villagers. Jump onto furniture and use hiding places to avoid detection before escaping after the task is complete.

pages.title: Autumn Girl Dress Up
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Create a seasonal outfit in Autumn Girl Dress Up. Choose the girl's hair, top, bottoms, and shoes, then add earrings or other decorations. Compare the available pieces to complete her autumn look.

pages.title: Blocks Jungle
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Remove matching groups in Blocks Jungle. Select clusters containing at least two pieces of the same color or animal design to clear them. Look for useful larger groups while working toward a better score.

pages.title: Euro Football Kick 2016
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Take tournament shots in Euro Football Kick 2016. Send the ball past the goalkeeper and score for your selected team. Build a stronger goal total as you compete through the European championship setting.

pages.title: Penguin vs Snowmen
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Protect a penguin's home in Penguin vs Snowmen. Shoot at the snowmen advancing toward the house and stop them before they break through. Keep responding to the attackers to maintain the defense.

pages.title: Ice Princess 2017 Trendsetter
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Give Anna a new style in Ice Princess 2017 Trendsetter. Choose makeup and explore the available clothing for her fashion presentation. Combine the different pieces into an outfit that completes the makeover.

pages.title: Reddy Princess Fashion
pages.creator: Next Vision Solutions
pages.description: Create an outfit in Reddy Princess Fashion. Browse the character's clothes and accessories, then choose combinations to build her look. Compare the available pieces before completing the princess's finished style.

pages.title: Ruby Dressing Room
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Help choose an outfit in Ruby Dressing Room. Mix dresses, skirts, blouses, and jackets from Ruby's wardrobe, then add a purse and necklace. Put together a coordinated look for her day out.
